messages:
sarah: Quick idea — March Survivor pool for the tournament? One pick per day (no repeats). Last person standing wins free lunch from the rest. Loser buys bagels for the office on Friday. Who's in? :basketball:
jamal: I'm in. What's the buy-in? $5? :thumbsup:
anya: in. but i'm cursed with upsets so tbh this is entertainment only 😂
mike: Count me in. Tiebreaker?
sarah: Tiebreaker = total points scored in the final game (closest wins). Buy-in $5 Venmo @sarah-redwood. Rules: no duplicate picks per person, must submit before tipoff. I'll set a tab with picks. If you miss a day you are eliminated.
kevin: wait what's 'no repeats' mean? can't pick the same team on multiple days?
sarah: correct — you can only pick each team once during the tournament. Helps spread picks.
jamal: ok putting $5 in. Also can we have a 'hero shot' insurance — 50c to buy-back if you accidentally miss? jk
anya: @sarah put me as 'anya' in the list pls. i'll try not to blow it.
ops-bot: calendar: March Survivor pool — daily pick deadline 30 minutes before tipoff — created by sarah.ics
mike: How do we record picks? Slack thread or google sheet?
sarah: I'll make a quick sheet and post the link. For ease, do /pick TEAMNAME in the thread and i'll transfer to the sheet. Example: /pick Gonzaga
kevin: /pick Kansas. let's go.
jamal: /pick Villanova
anya: /pick Michigan State — take the gamble
sarah: Link: https://docs.google.com/sheet... (I set headers: name | day1 | day2 | picks left). I'll update after work. Reminder: loser brings bagels Friday and labels them 'I lost to March' :bagel: :trophy:
mike: oh man that's cruel. but fair.
anya: can we have a spicy tie-break? like dunk contest? pls no
jamal: agreed no dunk contests. Also can we have a 'bench ban' — no picking teams on bye? lol
sarah: ok main rules stand. I'll lock picks 30m before tipoff. Good luck y'all. First bracket game starts 7pm. :basketball:
